about.label: > About me
about.title: Technical profile
about.paragraph1: I am a software developer focused on building modular systems, operational tools, and scalable backend services. My main stack includes Laravel, Vue.js, SQL, process automation, and API integrations.
about.paragraph2: I have worked on SaaS platforms, CRM systems, internal workflow automation, and operational tooling. I focus on maintainable architecture, backend processing, testing, and optimization of real-world workflows.
